derivation: STATE is banded on the worst room's CO2 in ppm, not on scrubber capacity: scrubbers are room-local and FlowAcrossDoor has no diffusion term, so nameplate capacity reads healthy while one room suffocates. LOAD is scrubber capacity against crew CO2 production.

OFFLINE is derived from the device census: the sensor pass never runs because no Telescope is placed anywhere on the ship. LOAD is -1 because there is nothing to load. Place a telescope and this row comes alive on its own.
